reports.title: Statistical Centre of Iran (SCI) institutional core
reports.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Iranian statistical system.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is in the high-80s to low-90s millions range in recent reports; urbanisation is advanced and the age structure is shifting toward aging.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~87–93 million depending on source and reference year.

reports.title: National Accounts of Iran (GDP)
reports.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran / Central Bank related
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for an oil-and-gas-influenced, sanctions-affected economy.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node.
reports._url_evidence: CBI page titled 'Annual National Accounts' (حساب‌های ملی سالانه) describing GDP time series at current and constant prices with base years 1383/1390/1395.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Iran has experienced prolonged high inflation; the CPI series is a critical high-frequency price and welfare signal.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node. High inflation environment gives this series elevated centrality.

reports.title: Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran institutional and reporting core
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iran (CBI)
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management, banking supervision and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate and related series.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to SCI.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iran
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Strongly influenced by oil and gas exports, sanctions regimes, and non-oil export performance.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with oil-dominated signature.
reports._url_evidence: CBI 'بخش تراز پرداخت‌ها' section; page states it contains balance of payments tables, customs exports/imports, external debt and monthly average dollar rates, with monthly PDFs.

reports.title: Iran foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from SCI and CBI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the SCI institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBI institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Iranian research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Iranian research.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Nuclear power generation statistics (Bushehr)
reports.publisher: Derived from IAEA PRIS and national energy sources
reports.description: Operational statistics for Iran’s nuclear power capacity, centred on the Bushehr-1 reactor (VVER, ~915 MWe net). Nuclear remains a small but strategically significant share of the power mix.
reports._notes: Nuclear densification of the power cluster. Distinct from the broader nuclear programme.
_referenced_by: Energy balance and Bushehr provincial analysis
reports._url_evidence: IAEA Country Nuclear Power Profile 2022 for Iran; gives Bushehr Unit 1 net capacity 915 MW(e) and 1.73% share of national generation in 2020.

reports.title: Iran–Eurasian Economic Union free trade framework

reports.title: Youth unemployment and youth labour-force statistics
reports.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran / related

reports.title: Crude oil and condensate production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Petroleum / OPEC / CBI related
reports.description: Official and industry statistics on crude oil and condensate production. Iran ranks among the largest OPEC producers and holds some of the world’s largest proved reserves. Production and export volumes are heavily conditioned by sanctions regimes.
reports._notes: Core hydrocarbon production node. Highest-centrality commodity uniqueness for Iran.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin site (59th edition), OPEC's official oil-data compilation covering member-country production; note it is the global ASB series page, not an Iran-specific page - OPEC country pages return HTTP 402 and mop.ir/nioc.ir are unreachable.

reports.title: Oil and petroleum product export statistics
reports.publisher: CBI / Ministry of Petroleum / shipping trackers
reports.description: Export volumes and estimated values for crude and petroleum products. Export levels fluctuate sharply with sanctions enforcement, buyer willingness (notably China), and shipping constraints. Strait of Hormuz remains the primary route.
reports._notes: Export-side densification of the oil cluster. Critical for external and fiscal balances.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved OPEC's Iran member-country facts-and-figures page. Shows Iran-specific 'Crude oil exports (1,000 b/d) 1,215', refinery capacity 1,715 kb/cd, refined output 1,918.4 kb/d, gas exports 9,307 mn cu m; footer states 'Source: Annual Statistical Bulletin 2014'. OPEC is a multilateral publisher. Note: the figures are dated (2014 ASB vintage); no Iranian government oil-export page could be retrieved — mop.ir and NIOC never answered.
reports._url_route: multilateral fallback (OPEC) after Ministry of Petroleum / NIOC remained unreachable

reports.title: Natural gas production and domestic consumption statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Petroleum / related
reports.description: Statistics on dry natural gas production and domestic use. Iran is among the world’s largest gas producers (South Pars field central); most output is absorbed domestically rather than exported as LNG.
reports._notes: Gas densification of the hydrocarbon cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved (twice, consistently) the Gas Exporting Countries Forum member page for Iran. Gives both series the node needs: 'Marketed production of natural gas (billion cu. m.) 199.3 (2013)' and 'Domestic Dry Natural gas consumption (incl. flared, shrinkage, gas to GTL plants, plant own use, losses and market production) (billion cu. m.) 199.292 (2013)'. GECF is a multilateral organisation of which Iran is a founding member. Figures are 2013 vintage.
reports._url_route: multilateral fallback (GECF) after mop.ir and nigc.ir stayed unreachable

reports.title: Social protection and cash-transfer statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from national and World Bank-aligned sources
reports.description: Statistics and indicators on social assistance, cash transfers and related social-protection programmes. Cash transfers and subsidy-related support interact tightly with high inflation and the targeted-subsidy system.
reports._notes: Social-protection densification linked to the subsidy and poverty clusters.
reports._url_evidence: PARTIAL MATCH — retrieved the US Social Security Administration's 'Social Security Programs Throughout the World: Asia and the Pacific, 2018' country chapter for Iran (a government publication). It documents Iran's five social-protection branches (old age/disability/survivors, sickness and maternity, work injury, unemployment, family allowances) with quantitative parameters: employee contribution 5% of monthly earnings, employer 14% of payroll, 3% of payroll for unemployment insurance; sickness benefit 75% and maternity 66% of average daily covered earnings; unemployment benefit 55% for up to 50 months; minimum-wage floor 11,112,690 rials. Caveat: these are programme rules and benefit formulas, not cash-transfer coverage/spending statistics. No Iranian official social-protection statistics page was reachable, and the ILO World Social Protection dashboards and social-protection.org country profile returned 500/no Iran-specific content.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.

url_partial_match.title: Tehran province Gross Regional Domestic Product
url_partial_match.caveat: PARTIAL MATCH — retrieved the Statistical Centre of Iran's national-and-regional accounts page, which states in Persian that this section provides 'سهم هر استان در تولید ناخالص داخلی' (the share of each province in gross domestic product) and discusses the regional accounts (حساب‌های منطقه‌ای) being compiled before national-account revisions. It is the official SCI product family that carries provincial GRDP, but it is a national page, not a Tehran-specific page. The province-specific regional-accounts page (…/دادهها-و-اطلاعات-آماری/حساب-های-ملی-و-منطقه‌ای/حساب‌های-منطقه‌ای) was located via search but never returned a response across ~15 attempts.
url_partial_match.second_opinion: Grok independently reached the same URL, so this is the best link that exists — not a shortcut. Treat the series-level match as final unless the publisher adds a per-node page.

url_partial_match.title: Social protection and cash-transfer statistics
url_partial_match.caveat: PARTIAL MATCH — retrieved the US Social Security Administration's 'Social Security Programs Throughout the World: Asia and the Pacific, 2018' country chapter for Iran (a government publication). It documents Iran's five social-protection branches (old age/disability/survivors, sickness and maternity, work injury, unemployment, family allowances) with quantitative parameters: employee contribution 5% of monthly earnings, employer 14% of payroll, 3% of payroll for unemployment insurance; sickness benefit 75% and maternity 66% of average daily covered earnings; unemployment benefit 55% for up to 50 months; minimum-wage floor 11,112,690 rials. Caveat: these are programme rules and benefit formulas, not cash-transfer coverage/spending statistics. No Iranian official social-protection statistics page was reachable, and the ILO World Social Protection dashboards and social-protection.org country profile returned 500/no Iran-specific content.
url_partial_match.second_opinion: Grok independently reached the same URL, so this is the best link that exists — not a shortcut. Treat the series-level match as final unless the publisher adds a per-node page.
